hypothesis: On this source, Hindi V3 CTA clipped at both sides; V4 reduced its font size from 230 to 136 and the reviewed entrance, hold and tail samples fit. Vietnamese required testing actual diacritic glyph coverage: the selected Helvetica Neue faces supported the reviewed text while the earlier Arial Rounded/Narrow choices did not. Korean prototype speech required extending the selected source-audio cut from 5.35 to 5.65 seconds to retain the observed voice boundary at 5.37125 seconds. These are source-scoped repair observations; font size and timing values are not reusable defaults.
limitations: One source only; no cross-source causal validation.
No direct listening, normal-speed continuous playback or independent acceptance.
Adapted type style, texture changes and approximate reveal/sparkle remain.
Audio-model spelling and pronunciation uncertainty remains unresolved.
next_action: Review preserved observations and actual media before activation; do not infer perceptual quality acceptance from platform binding.
